headline: Eli Lilly Highlights Weight Loss Benefits For Women Across Menopausal Stages
summary: Eli Lilly reports Foundayo delivered significant weight loss across menopausal stages, with up to 14.4% reductions at 72 weeks.

headline: Eli Lilly Announces Data From Three Phase 3 Studies Of Foundayo In ACHIEVE Program Surpasses Oral Semaglutide Throughout Primary, Secondary Endpoints In Adults With Type 2 Diabetes
